guard: backup accepts the exact stopped whole-KV scanner shape without accepting arbitrary ordered consumers
why: The behavior is a boundary, not a one-way relaxation. One mutation restores the shipped false
refusal by dropping DeliverPolicy.All. The other removes the exact filter-subject check, which
would accept a genuinely unhealthy lookalike. Both run backup create against disposable real
broker stores, so the proof reaches the inventory guard through the public command path.

mutations.name: the sanctioned whole-KV scanner policy is refused again
mutations.expectRed: backup accepts a healthy stamp with stopped kv-scan residue
mutations.cell: backup accepts a healthy stamp with stopped kv-scan residue
mutations.note: This is the exact pre-fix guard and reproduces issue #991.

mutations.name: the exact KV filter boundary is removed
mutations.expectRed: backup still refuses an unhealthy ordered-consumer lookalike
mutations.cell: backup still refuses an unhealthy ordered-consumer lookalike
mutations.note: The lookalike keeps every ordered-consumer field except the bucket filter, so accepting it would turn the false-positive fix into a custody hole.
